title: Possessive Adjectives
summary: Possessive adjectives replace articles before nouns: my book, her car. Match the owner: his = a man/boy, her = a woman/g
rule: Possessive adjectives replace articles before nouns: my book, her car. Match the owner: his = a man/boy, her = a woman/girl, their = plural.
tutorHints: Contrast she/her and he/his on the board.
